nodes.name: sdk_compiler_helper.cmake
nodes.summary: Cinema 4D 2024 compatibility shim that forwards compiler-helper behavior to the shared stable SDK toolchain. / Cinema 4D 2024 兼容垫片，将编译器辅助行为转发到共享的稳定 SDK 工具链。

nodes.name: sdk_library_template.cmake
nodes.summary: Auto-generated cross-platform target template that expands projectdefinition metadata into Maxon SDK target variables and target processing. / 自动生成的跨平台目标模板，将 projectdefinition 元数据展开为 Maxon SDK 目标变量并执行目标处理。

nodes.name: sdk_targets.cmake
nodes.summary: Cinema 4D 2024 compatibility shim that forwards target creation and resource logic to the shared stable SDK implementation. / Cinema 4D 2024 兼容垫片，将目标创建与资源逻辑转发到共享的稳定 SDK 实现。

nodes.name: sdk_update_projects.cmake
nodes.summary: Cinema 4D 2024 compatibility shim that forwards module discovery and project-update logic to the shared SDK implementation. / Cinema 4D 2024 兼容垫片，将模块发现与工程更新逻辑转发到共享 SDK 实现。

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Cinema 4D 2024 bridge root that configures C++20, loads compatibility tooling, discovers modules, and prepares framework and plugin outputs. / Cinema 4D 2024 桥接根工程，负责配置 C++20、加载兼容工具、发现模块并准备框架与插件输出。

nodes.name: CMakePresets.json
nodes.summary: Cross-platform Cinema 4D 2024 configure presets for Ninja, universal Xcode, Visual Studio v143, and ClangCL build trees. / Cinema 4D 2024 的跨平台配置预设，覆盖 Ninja、通用 Xcode、Visual Studio v143 与 ClangCL 构建树。

nodes.name: mmdtool.xdl64.manifest
nodes.summary: Windows plugin manifest requesting as-invoker execution and per-monitor DPI awareness for the 2024 xdl64 binary. / Windows 插件清单，为 2024 xdl64 二进制声明普通用户权限与按显示器 DPI 感知。

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Thin Cinema 4D 2024 plugin wrapper that reuses the shared dependency layer, canonical source tree, current resources, and common plugin setup. / 精简的 Cinema 4D 2024 插件包装层，复用共享依赖层、规范源码树、当前资源与公共插件设置。

nodes.name: mmdtool.vcxproj
nodes.summary: Generated Visual Studio dynamic-library project listing MMD Tool sources, Maxon framework imports, build configurations, and framework project references. / 生成的 Visual Studio 动态库工程，列出 MMD Tool 源码、Maxon 框架导入、构建配置与框架工程引用。

nodes.name: mmdtool.vcxproj.filters
nodes.summary: Visual Studio filter map organizing the generated MMD Tool source and header entries into IDE folders. / Visual Studio 筛选器映射，将生成的 MMD Tool 源码与头文件条目组织到 IDE 文件夹中。

nodes.name: mmdtool.vcxproj.user
nodes.summary: Workstation-local Visual Studio debugger settings that launch Cinema 4D 2024 with the plugin module path. / 工作站本地 Visual Studio 调试设置，用指定插件模块路径启动 Cinema 4D 2024。

nodes.name: project.pbxproj
nodes.summary: Generated Xcode project for the macOS mmdtool dynamic library, including source groups, Maxon framework projects, configurations, and products. / 生成的 macOS mmdtool 动态库 Xcode 工程，包含源码分组、Maxon 框架工程、构建配置与产品。

nodes.name: projectdefinition.txt
nodes.summary: Reference-only Maxon plugin metadata recording platforms, DLL type, framework APIs, module identity, encoding, and exception settings. / 仅供参考的 Maxon 插件元数据，记录平台、DLL 类型、框架 API、模块标识、编码与异常设置。

nodes.name: projectsettings.props
nodes.summary: MSBuild property sheet defining the Maxon SDK root macro and USE_API_MAXON preprocessor definition for the generated project. / MSBuild 属性表，为生成工程定义 Maxon SDK 根目录宏与 USE_API_MAXON 预处理定义。

nodes.name: projectdefinition.txt
nodes.summary: Maxon solution metadata selecting the mmdtool plugin project for Win64 and macOS generation. / Maxon 解决方案元数据，选择在 Win64 与 macOS 上生成 mmdtool 插件工程。

nodes.name: compile_definitions.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines common, debug, release, and Windows Maxon SDK preprocessor symbols for 64-bit plugin targets. / 定义 64 位插件目标使用的通用、调试、发布与 Windows Maxon SDK 预处理符号。

nodes.name: compile_options.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines compiler- and platform-specific optimization, debugging, ISA, language, visibility, and reproducibility options for SDK targets. / 定义 SDK 目标按编译器与平台区分的优化、调试、指令集、语言、可见性与可复现性选项。

nodes.name: link_options.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines shared Windows and Linux linker flags, debug information policy, ASLR, and dead-code folding behavior. / 定义共享的 Windows 与 Linux 链接器标志、调试信息策略、ASLR 与无用代码折叠行为。

nodes.name: sanitize.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines AddressSanitizer compile definitions and compile or link options for supported release-mode sanitizer builds. / 定义受支持发布模式消毒构建的 AddressSanitizer 编译定义及编译或链接选项。

nodes.name: warnings.clang.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines Clang warnings promoted to errors plus version-specific warning suppressions required by the Maxon SDK codebase. / 定义提升为错误的 Clang 警告，以及 Maxon SDK 代码库所需的按版本警告抑制项。

nodes.name: warnings.gcc.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines GCC warning suppressions and selected error-level diagnostics for C and C++ SDK targets. / 定义 C 与 C++ SDK 目标的 GCC 警告抑制项及选定的错误级诊断。

nodes.name: warnings.msvc.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines the MSVC warning suppression set and selected warnings promoted to errors for SDK compilation. / 定义 SDK 编译使用的 MSVC 警告抑制集合及提升为错误的选定警告。

nodes.name: create_directory_symlink.cmake
nodes.summary: Script-mode CMake command that validates path arguments and delegates creation of a directory link to the SDK target utilities. / 脚本模式 CMake 命令，校验路径参数并委托 SDK 目标工具创建目录链接。

nodes.name: update_filelist.cmake
nodes.summary: Script-mode CMake command that normalizes search directories and refreshes generated source file lists, with stricter Xcode change handling. / 脚本模式 CMake 命令，规范化搜索目录并刷新生成的源码文件列表，同时对 Xcode 变更采用更严格处理。

nodes.name: sdk_compiler_helper.cmake
nodes.summary: Central Maxon SDK compiler helper that identifies toolchains and applies warning policy, ISA flags, compile definitions, RTTI, exceptions, linker options, and framework links. / Maxon SDK 中央编译器辅助层，负责识别工具链并应用警告策略、指令集标志、编译定义、RTTI、异常、链接选项与框架链接。
